thesis.text: Asiamet has completed the KSK Project (Indokal) sale to Norin Mining for US$104.9 million and declared a US$93.0 million special dividend (~US$0.0268/share), payable 29 Sep 2026 [uk:9762782]. With KSK monetized, the Company's sole remaining asset is the Beutong Project in Aceh, Indonesia, for which the Board is still 'evaluating all available options' with local and government stakeholders [uk:9762782]. The near-term catalyst is confirmation of the GBP dividend rate and successful payment; the medium-term catalyst is any strategic update on Beutong's path forward (JV, sale, or development), which will determine Asiamet's residual value beyond the cash distribution.
